entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 于「ó…」后残缺，且 H/M/R 三栏皆空，仅能推测指天气此刻转缓。

entries.zh: 俯身、低下身体（如后文所示）
entries.en: to bow, to lower the body (as shown below)
entries.notes: M「pag sūn」未详，仅据 L 与「como abaxo」立义。

entries.zh: 把掉落的物件（如吊灯）放低、放平
entries.en: to lower something fallen (e.g. a hanging lamp) down to level

entries.zh: 织布时把纬线向下推压
entries.en: to press/beat the weft down in weaving

entries.zh: 把旗竿或旗子降下；降旗
entries.en: to lower a flag or flagpole, as a pennant; to strike a flag
entries.notes: L 之 cauandera/bariedola 疑为旗竿与 banderola（三角小旗），M「quī」疑读「旗」。

entries.zh: 用钩子把东西钩下来
entries.en: to hook something down; to lower it with a hook
entries.notes: L「congruato」当读作 con garabato（钩），M「cau lō tay」可读为「鉤落底」。

entries.zh: 天降大水；洪水
entries.en: to send down water from the sky, as in a deluge; a deluge

entries.zh: 天降大火；火灾
entries.en: to rain down fire from heaven; a conflagration

entries.zh: 天降冰雹（成灾）
entries.en: to come down from the sky as hail
entries.notes: M 首音节「ttzō」未详，「cháy hāy」可读为「災害」。

entries.zh: 翻滚着落下；转着往下掉
entries.en: to come down turning or rolling; to tumble down
entries.notes: M「pag tūn tūy」疑为「跋轉墜」一类，字未全定。

entries.zh: 把东西转着、扭着弄下来
entries.en: to pull something down with a twisting motion

entries.zh: 自天而降、降生成人（道成肉身）
entries.en: to come down from heaven, as God in the flesh (the Incarnation)
entries.notes: 「Dios en carne」指道成肉身，M「cāng in」次音节疑为「孕」。

entries.zh: 就这样降下；降世（降临人间）
entries.en: to come down thus; to descend into the world
entries.notes: 「Abaxar así」本页四见，M 分作降世、降下、降凡、降胎，并为「降下」之别。

entries.zh: 就这样降下；放下
entries.en: to come down thus; to put or bring down

entries.zh: 就这样降下；降凡（下到人间）
entries.en: to come down thus; to descend to the mortal world

entries.zh: 就这样降下；降胎（降入母胎）
entries.en: to come down thus; to descend into the womb

entries.zh: 降临（如圣神降临）
entries.en: to come down, as the Holy Spirit (to descend upon)

entries.zh: 降痰；把痰化下、咳出
entries.en: to bring down phlegm; to clear or expectorate phlegm

entries.zh: 使体内之气或体液下行；无法使其下行
entries.en: to bring down the humour (qi); not to be able to bring it down
entries.notes: L「bumon」未能确读，M「quī」或为「氣」，义不能定。

entries.zh: 贬降职位；降低身份、尊严
entries.en: to lower (someone's) dignity or rank; to demote

entries.zh: 降火；把火势压下、熄灭
entries.en: to lower the fire; to quench or allay it

entries.zh: （鸟）飞落、栖下
entries.en: (of a bird) to come down, to alight

entries.zh: 像蚂蚁一样沿墙爬下
entries.en: to descend like an ant along a wall
entries.notes: M「chiū chī tay」未能确读，仅据 L 立义。

entries.zh: 放低或清空便器、水肥（存疑）
entries.en: to lower or empty a privy or liquid manure (uncertain)
entries.notes: L「Camarea」疑为 cámara（便所/便器），M 疑为「水肥…」，未能定夺。
